source_scope: Original user-supplied USAP-DC ZIPs in current conversation; original uncompressed bytes independently checked against publisher MD5
operational_primary_definition: Band ID mapped to unique original band range; orig_col matches banding colony; proofed=1; bandseen=Y; date and season agree; status=INC & nuegg in {1,2} OR status=BR & nuch in {1,2}; status definitions operational pending formal data dictionary
natal_origin_difference_definition: Original band range type CHIC (banded as chick) and resighting season at least two years later; primary active nest documented at colony different from banded origin
inferential_guardrails: These are detected individual cases, not population rates or detection-adjusted dispersal estimates.
No movement date is known between two seasons of observed nesting; other breeding years may be unobserved.
Site/year search effort and detectability differ greatly and no effort model was fitted.
The field-status codebook was not present inside the two uploaded ZIPs; INC and BR with source egg/chick counts are an operational conservative rule.
CHIC band-inventory ID ranges stand in for chick-banding year/origin; not original individual-level hatch records.

Already-known literature Dugger et al. 2010 PNAS DOI 10.1073/pnas.1000623107 and Dugger et al. 2026 Frontiers DOI 10.3389/fevo.2026.1868960 analyzed movement; this is original-data reconstruction not first biological discovery.
Not a Circuitscape penguin resistance calibration; no climate causal effect, future SSP biological forecast or transfer to western Antarctic Peninsula.
privacy_and_provenance: No original bird ID, observer initials, free-text notes, or complete raw records included in this public aggregate
